definitions.explanation: Refers to the recent past, from a few days to several weeks ago, up to the present. Can function as a noun or adverb.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}、⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{最近|さいきん}、⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ました→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Have you seen any movies lately?

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.notes: Used as noun modifier with の

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できました→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I made a new friend recently.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{起|お}きて→起きる：00521_okiru⟧、⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ようにしています→ようにする：10987_younisuru⟧。
examples.english: Lately I've been waking up early every morning and going for walks.

notes:
{最近|さいきん} functions as both a noun and adverb meaning "recently" or "lately."

GRAMMAR PATTERNS:
- {最近|さいきん}、～ (adverb): Recently, ~
- {最近|さいきん}の + noun: recent ~
- {最近|さいきん}は: these days, lately

TIME SCOPE:
Covers the recent past - from a few days to several weeks. More recent than {以前|いぜん} (before) but broader than {昨日|きのう} (yesterday).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最近|さいきん}の{ニュース|にゅーす}: recent news
- {最近|さいきん}の{調子|ちょうし}は?: How have you been lately?
- ごく{最近|さいきん}: very recently

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {近頃|ちかごろ}: lately (slightly more formal)
- この{頃|ごろ}: these days (casual)
